_note: Freeze-#1-compatible sidecar consumed by eval.cases.load_cases: {base_case_id: [entries]} where an int is a 0-based index into the BASE case's reference_targets_freetext and a str is a canonical record id from discriminator_ids.json. eval.metrics scores perturbation responsiveness as hits/len(entries) on the _p1 output (int -> target_present; str -> record id on the card, or its verified-record title matched in item text). Entries are the items expected_change says become must-have, rise, lead, or remain must-have AND are the discriminator of the differential that now leads; items that only drop, remain should-still-include, or plainly remain must-have are excluded. Record-id strings only score when the verified store carries that record (they never hit in --smoke, whose store is synthetic). Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the loader. Drops live in benchmark/expected_change_drops.json.

abdominal_pain_002: Ask about prior biliary stents or ERCP
abdominal_pain_003: Ask about back or flank pain
aki_001: Ask about recent large-volume paracentesis and lactulose or diuretic doses
dizziness_002: Ask about oral intake, blood loss, and fluid balance since surgery
fever_001: Ask about flatus, bowel function, and drain output
fever_002: Arthrocentesis (moves to the off-bedside list; not a card item)
fever_003: Stool testing (off-bedside; not a card item)
hypotension_001: Surgical site, drain, and thigh inspection for hematoma
hypotension_002: Ask about oral intake, vomiting, or diarrhea
syncope_002: Ask about oral intake, diuretics, and days in bed
weakness_001: Ask about ear pain, hyperacusis, and taste change
